blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Did the President deliver his predecessor? On Friday, Vice President Sara Duterte questioned whether Palace press officer Claire Castro was admitting that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. had a hand in bringing former President Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague, Netherlands, to face charges of crimes against humanity over his administration’s drug war.
